deadline.value: Apply by January 15, 2027 for entrance-award consideration and the best chance at your preferred group; the Fall 2027 application window runs October 16, 2026 to May 31, 2027.
deadline.quote: Applicants are encouraged to apply before January 15, though the admission system remains open until May 31.

also.quote: PhD in Physics, Accepting applications for Fall 2027 start: October 16, 2026 -May 31, 2027. Please apply by January 15 to be considered for entrance awards.

gre_subject.value: The physics pages checked do not mention the GRE.

supervisor.value: No supervisor is needed before applying, but applicants are encouraged to identify and contact potential supervisors and can list up to five faculty in the application.
supervisor.quote: No, it is not necessary to find a supervisor prior to applying. However, students preparing applications are encouraged to read faculty research profiles, identify potential supervisors, and make contact with them.

also.quote: If possible, applicants should indicate the top five SFU faculty members with whom they are interested in working

funding.value: Financial support is guaranteed for all admitted physics graduate students and covers tuition and fees; internationals pay the same tuition as domestic students.
funding.quote: Financial support is guaranteed for all graduate students accepted into the program. | International students are charged the same tuition and fees as our domestic students.

entry_route.value: Master's or equivalent required; BSc holders cannot apply directly but can transfer from the MSc
entry_route.quote: A master's degree, or the equivalent is required. | Note that BSc degree-holders may not apply directly to the PhD program, but may apply for transfer to the PhD program without completing an MSc degree.

english_waiver.value: Exempt only if BOTH: degree taught and examined in English AND institution in an English-primary country (list linked); otherwise submit scores
english_waiver.quote: International applicants are exempt from providing English test scores if both of the following conditions are met: They have completed a post-secondary degree at an institution where the language of instruction and examination was in English. That the institution was located in a country where English is the primary language (including Canada).

notes: PhD starts possible in September, January or May.
